::: {.hero-pair}
[`{python} f"{biplane_sink:.3f}"`]{.hero-value}
[biplane sink rate (m/s)]{.hero-label}

[`{python} f"{monoplane_sink:.3f}"`]{.hero-value}
[monoplane sink rate (m/s)]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** No. The fully optimized biplane achieves a sink rate of `{python} f"{biplane_sink:.3f}"` m/s, which is worse than the `{python} f"{monoplane_sink:.3f}"` m/s achieved by the [monoplane](2026-09-16-01-what-sink-rate-is-achieved-when-all-geometry-parameters-are-optimized.qmd). Because 3 mm foam already withstands 1g flight loads easily, the structural bracing advantage of a biplane is not needed, and the aerodynamic penalty of increased wetted area and interference drag dominates.
